# hybrid-rag-mcp

> Local-first hybrid-RAG MCP server (Qdrant + BM25 via RRF), multi-step agent, offline Ollama fallback. Leia em [português](README.pt-BR.md).

- [README](README.md): setup, tools, metrics, deploy, observability
- [Architecture decisions](docs/adr/): RRF weights, storage, cache, judge, lazy-init, integrations
- [Contributing](CONTRIBUTING.md): lint, mypy strict, tests, commit style
- [Changelog](CHANGELOG.md): release history
- [Configuration](.env.example): all env vars (Ollama, cloud, Qdrant, cache, auth)
- [Answer eval set](eval/answers.jsonl): 12 grounded Q&A pairs used by the llm-as-judge
- [Retrieval eval sets](eval/dataset.jsonl): 12 hand-curated queries + auto-generated `eval/dataset.real.jsonl`
- [Demo](examples/demo.sh): ingest + search + ask in ~1 min (needs Ollama)

## Tools (MCP)

- `ingest(corpus_dir="")`: index md/txt/pdf into Qdrant + BM25 (incremental, idempotent)
- `search(query, top_k=5)`: hybrid search returning snippets + sources
- `ask(question, top_k=5)`: multi-step RAG with cited sources (checks semantic cache first)
- `metrics()`: server counters + p50/p95 latencies since boot

## Transports

- stdio (default): `python -m hybrid_rag_mcp`
- streamable HTTP: `python -m hybrid_rag_mcp --transport http --port 8000` (`GET /mcp`, `GET /metrics`)
- HTTP auth (optional): `MCP_AUTH_TOKEN` bearer token on server and client

## Extension seams

- Compressor: any `(str) -> str` callable via `CONTEXT_COMPRESSOR=pkg.mod:func` (or built-in levels `CONTEXT_COMPRESSION=0|1|2`)
- Embeddings/LLM: `EmbeddingProvider` / `LLMProvider` ABCs (`src/hybrid_rag_mcp/providers/`); cloud via `CLOUD_*` env vars
- Reranker: duck-type `score(query, texts) -> list[float]` (see `providers/rerank.py`)
